items.action: Hard-refresh hackme.tech index/docs after deploy; reference docs/ECONOMICS_DASHBOARD.md §8 for formulas.

items.title: Public Economics Model (Chain · Pool · Orders)
items.summary: A dedicated site page and docs cross-links explain how PoH block credits (primary wallet on the producing node), coordinator worker accrual/settlement, and paid audit orders fit together — explicitly not classic Ethereum-style pooled block subsidy.
items.impact: Miners and partners get a single reference for expectations: block header transparency vs wallet credit path, and why fleet income follows coordinator policy.
items.action: Share economics-model.html from the Docs hub; operators keep settlement automation and dashboards as the source of truth for accrued vs settled HMC.

items.title: Release Fast-Pack PASS + Final Linux/Windows Artifacts
items.summary: Final fast-profile release validation passed end-to-end (health, ultimate quick gate, security assertions, and worker dominance), and fresh Linux/Windows binaries were rebuilt with new SHA256 checksums.
items.impact: Operators can deploy updated binaries with a deterministic release checklist and shorter, timeout-safe validation flow.
items.action: Deploy dist/release_final_20260507 binaries to VPS, publish SHA256SUMS.txt with the release post, and run post-deploy smoke checks on status/work/global metrics.

items.title: RC7 Release Pack + Hybrid Anti-Replay Hardening
items.summary: Release 0.1.0-rc7 artifacts for Linux and Windows were rebuilt with fresh checksums, while coordinator Hybrid signer received stricter anti-replay and duplicate-signed-payload protections.
items.impact: Operators can distribute updated binaries and run stronger pool-side submit validation without breaking current worker-mode staging flow.
items.action: Use dist/release_0.1.0-rc7 artifacts, keep predeploy gate with hybrid smoke enabled, and canary-enable strict signer mode before full rollout.

items.title: Auto-Settlement Timers are Live
items.summary: Systemd automation for worker payout settlement is now active with periodic settlement and healthcheck timers on the canonical VPS.
items.impact: Worker accrual can now be settled to on-chain wallet balances automatically, reducing manual intervention and payout drift.
items.action: Monitor settlement services via systemctl and journalctl; adjust MIN_SETTLE_HMC and payout mapping in /opt/hackme/.env.settlement as needed.

items.title: V3 Worker Settlement Bridge Added
items.summary: A new settlement operator script converts coordinator off-chain worker accrual into on-chain transfer payouts with nonce-safe submission and self-pay protection.
items.impact: Operators can now automate payout settlement from worker accrual counters to real wallet balances, reducing confusion between accrued and settled rewards.
items.action: Use scripts/ops/settle_worker_payouts.sh with payout mapping (or hybrid signed payout_address) and a minimum settlement threshold.

items.title: Hybrid Signer v2 Dark Launch (Safe Fallback Active)
items.summary: Coordinator now supports optional miner-signed submit payloads with ed25519 verification, replay protection, and deterministic reject reasons. Backward-compatible unsigned worker flow remains active.
items.impact: Pool operators can enable Hybrid v2 gradually without breaking existing worker clients, while gaining signer telemetry and stricter anti-abuse validation.
items.action: Enable HACKME_POOL_HYBRID_SIGNER_ENABLED=1 on coordinator, run hybrid_signer_smoke.sh, and rollout workers in phases.

items.title: Predeploy Gate Added, Canonical Ops Pass Confirmed
items.summary: A new one-command predeploy gate is now live with practical checks for test suite, canonical proxy parity, wallet source consistency, and worker-mode health. Public stack deployment completed successfully after gate pass.
items.impact: Operators can validate follower and worker readiness before rollout with a deterministic PASS/FAIL flow, reducing drift between local dashboards and canonical chain reality.
items.action: Run scripts/ops/predeploy_gate.sh before each public deployment and monitor worker-mode health and canonical parity in regular operations.

items.title: Telegram Channel Bot is Live
items.summary: Official HackMe channel automation is now active: new News entries are published directly to Telegram with status, impact, action, and deep links.
items.impact: Community updates now ship in real time without waiting for manual reposts, improving communication reliability for miners and operators.
items.action: Follow the official channel and use the News page as the source of truth for release and operations updates.

items.title: Canonical Consistency Upgrade for Follower Nodes
items.summary: Follower-mode APIs now mirror canonical chain responses for transfer pool, address lookups, transaction lookups, and status economics to prevent mixed local/canonical views.
items.impact: Operators now see one consistent reality between local dashboard/explorer and the public VPS chain, including nonce and pending transaction behavior.
items.action: Recommended: hard-refresh browser cache and restart local follower nodes to pick up latest frontend/backend behavior.

items.title: Simple Send Nonce Auto-Sync
items.summary: In network mode, simple wallet sends now auto-resolve nonce from canonical address state before submission, reducing invalid nonce conflicts after included transactions.
items.impact: Transfer UX is smoother for users operating in follower mode against a canonical VPS node.
items.action: No manual nonce management required in simple mode.

items.title: VPS Sweep Behavior Clarified
items.summary: Automated sweep-to-primary flow on VPS remains active to keep miner wallet near reserve and consolidate balances to the primary policy wallet.
items.impact: Miner wallet balance may look nearly static while rewards continue to accrue and be transferred to the primary address.
items.action: Use canonical address API for both miner and primary addresses when auditing balances.

items.title: Release Candidate 0.1.0-rc6 Published
items.summary: RC6 release bundles, checksums, and deployment automation were refreshed with latest stability and validation updates.
items.impact: Improved deployment consistency and repeatability across local and VPS environments.
items.action: Operators should use only RC6 artifacts from the Downloads page.

items.title: Security Hardening Pack Extended
items.summary: WASM validation gates, signature checks, and fail-closed controls were expanded and integrated into daily/ultimate validation packs.
items.impact: Lower risk of unsafe task execution and stronger deterministic verification in pipeline.
